raw_camera_calibration.intrinsics_usage: K/D apply to the original, unmirrored, uncropped native images only.

usage: Temporary calibration for real-robot-only training and inference. front_1 K and D are the measured LRCP 640x480 intrinsics. left and right T_base_camera are identity and were not measured. Do not mix these episodes with ego data or with episodes that use measured extrinsics.
